stageAdjustment.statement: in Stage 4 teachers may adjust the Stage 5 outcomes as appropriate to the needs of students in Years 7 and 8

outcomes.AGT5-SAF-01: applies production processes and safe work practices in agricultural contexts
outcomes.AGT5-APG-01: explains factors that influence animal and plant selection, growth and development in agricultural enterprises and systems
outcomes.AGT5-PRA-01: explains industry practices in agricultural enterprises and systems
outcomes.AGT5-ENV-01: analyses relationships between agricultural production, sustainability and consumers
outcomes.AGT5-IVT-01: investigates and assesses the influence of innovation and management practices on agricultural enterprises and systems
outcomes.AGT5-USE-01: selects and justifies the use of technologies and processes in agricultural production and systems
outcomes.AGT5-COM-01: communicates ideas and concepts in agricultural technology contexts
